collections.title: Campus Café Orientation
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the campus café orientation campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to the Campus Cafe.
Please wait calmly in the line.
You can order coffee, tea, or snacks.
Hot drinks come in three different sizes today.
Reusable cups earn a small discount at checkout today for students.
If you have allergies, ask the barista to check ingredient labels carefully first.
Before leaving, return trays, wipe your table, and recycle bottles, cups, and paper sleeves properly.

collections.title: Library Print Station
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the library print station campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to the print station.
Log in with your student ID.
Use double-sided printing to save paper today.
Black and white pages cost 10 cents per page only.
Color printing costs more and uses special cues during rush hours.
Ask a librarian for help if your file format causes errors today.
Before you leave, pick up every page, remove staples, and recycle unwanted drafts responsibly, please.

collections.title: Fitness Center Sign-Up
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the fitness center sign-up campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to the fitness center.
Memberships are completely free for students.
Register online using your campus email address.
Attend an orientation before using any weight machines.
Locker rentals require a small refundable deposit paid each semester.
Trainers can design simple workout plans for beginners and returning athletes as well.
Before leaving today, return borrowed towels, clean mats thoroughly, and report any equipment problems immediately.

collections.title: Student Services Appointment Desk
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the student services appointment desk campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to Student Services Reception.
Please check in at the kiosk.
Use your ID to confirm your appointment.
Walk-ins are accepted during posted office hours only.
For financial questions, bring documents like invoices and scholarship letters.
Advisors can meet in person or online, depending on your schedule.
Before you leave, confirm next steps, print your receipt, and sign up for reminder emails.

collections.title: Campus Transit Ticket Kiosk
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the campus transit ticket kiosk campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to the ticket kiosk.
Touch the screen to begin.
Choose your route and travel direction.
Select a pass, single ride, day, or weekly.
Insert your card or pay using contactless mobile wallet here.
For discounts, verify your student status before completing the transaction.
After printing, take your pass, check platform signs, and board only when your train arrives.

collections.title: Campus Recycling Center
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the campus recycling center campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to the Recycling Center.
Separate paper, glass, and plastic carefully.
Food waste goes into the compost bin only.
Bottles and cans must be rinsed before recycling.
Electronics should be dropped off at the Tech Recycling Station.
Recycling correctly keeps our campus clean and protects the environment we all share.
Before leaving, please check every bin label carefully to make sure you're recycling each item properly.

collections.title: Computer Lab Orientation
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the computer lab orientation campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to the computer lab.
Log in using your student ID.
Save all your files in the cloud.
Printing costs $0.10 per page only.
Do not install games or personal software on lab computers.
Always log out before you leave to protect your private information.
If you need technical help, contact the lab assistant sitting near the back of the room.

collections.title: Dormitory Safety Orientation
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the dormitory safety orientation campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to your new dormitory.
Always lock your door when leaving.
Quiet hours begin at 10 p.m.
Do not light candles or burn incense inside.
Report maintenance issues to the front desk immediately.
Guests must sign in at the security desk before entering the building.
Before vacations, unplug electronics, empty your trash, and check that your windows are securely closed.

collections.title: Campus Health Clinic Visit
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the campus health clinic visit campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to the Campus Health Clinic.
Check in using your student ID card.
Wait quietly until your name is called.
Bring your insurance information to each visit.
For emergencies, call the nurse directly or dial the campus number posted.
Doctors usually see patients in order of appointment time unless it's urgent.
Before leaving, confirm your next visit, collect prescriptions, and stop by the front desk for receipts.

collections.title: Art Supply Store Visit
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the art supply store visit campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to the art supply store.
Sketchbooks are on the first shelf.
The paint brushes come in several different sizes.
You can test markers on the sample page provided.
Ask for student discounts before paying at the counter.
Store staff can help you find eco-friendly or professional-grade materials for your art class.
Before you check out, double check your list to make sure you have every color and tool you need.

collections.title: Campus Bookstore Orientation
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the campus bookstore orientation campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to the campus bookstore.
Textbooks are organized by course number.
Please bring your student ID for discounts.
You can rent or buy used textbooks here.
Return policies are printed on the back of your receipt.
Supplies like pens, notebooks, and calculators are available near the front counter.
Before checking out, review your shopping list carefully to make sure you have everything for class.

collections.title: Career Center Introduction
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the career center introduction campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to the Career Center.
We help students find jobs and internships.
Bring your resume for a free review.
Workshops are held every Tuesday afternoon here.
Employers often visit campus during the fall semester.
Schedule one-on-one appointments to discuss interview skills and career planning strategies.
Before graduating, attend the job fair to meet recruiters and explore professional networking opportunities.

collections.title: Student Club Fair
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the student club fair campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to the Student Club Fair.
You can join any club for free.
Each booth represents a different student organization.
Sign up using your name and campus email address.
Ask members questions about their upcoming events and projects.
Volunteering through clubs helps you meet new friends and gain leadership experience.
Before you leave today, check the schedule board to learn about our next community service opportunities.

collections.title: Science Lab Orientation
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the science lab orientation campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to the Science Laboratory.
Always wear your safety goggles.
Do not eat or drink inside the lab.
Label all your samples before beginning the experiment.
Report broken equipment to your instructor immediately.
Dispose of chemicals in the containers marked for hazardous waste only.
Before leaving wash your hands thoroughly and clean every surface you use during the experiment.

collections.title: Campus Bus Stop Directions
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the campus bus stop directions campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to the campus bus stop.
Buses arrive every 15 minutes.
Show your ID card when you board.
Wait behind the yellow safety line, please.
Seats near the driver are reserved for passengers with disabilities.
Use the app to check live arrival times before you leave the dorm.
When exiting, thank the driver politely and wait until the bus has completely stopped moving.

collections.title: Campus Cafeteria Orientation
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the campus cafeteria orientation campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to the campus cafeteria.
Please form a line for entry.
Show your ID before you grab a tray.
Use tongs when serving food from the salad bar.
Hot meals and vegetarian dishes are available every afternoon.
You can request allergy-friendly meals by speaking with a dining supervisor first.
After finishing your lunch, return trays, separate recyclables, and weed the table clean for others.

collections.title: Dormitory Checkout Instructions
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the dormitory checkout instructions campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to the dorm check out session.
Start by removing all personal items.
Empty drawers, closets, and the refrigerator completely.
Clean your desk, windows, and bathroom sink.
Return your key to the front desk before leaving.
A staff member will inspect your room for damage after you check out.
Make sure you complete the online departure form and pay any outstanding housing fees before the deadline.

collections.title: Volunteer Center Orientation
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the volunteer center orientation campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to the Volunteer Center.
We connect students with community projects.
Sign up using your university email address.
You can volunteer during weekends or holidays.
Orientation sessions are required before your first event.
Please arrive on time and wear comfortable clothes for outdoor activities.
After each project, submit your reflection report and record your hours in the volunteer portal.

collections.title: Campus Museum Tour
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the campus museum tour campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to the University Museum.
Please keep your voice low inside.
Do not touch the ancient artifacts.
Photography is allowed without flash only.
Guided tours begin every 30 minutes near the entrance.
You can learn more by scanning the QR codes beside each exhibit display.
Before you leave, visit the gift shop downstairs to purchase souvenirs and historical guidebooks.

collections.title: Tutoring and Writing Lab
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the tutoring and writing lab campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to the Campus Writing Lab.
Tutors help with essays and reports.
Make an appointment online before visiting.
Bring your Draft and Assignment sheet with you.
Each session lasts about 30 minutes with a peer tutor.
Tutors focus on structure, clarity, and grammar, but never rewrite your paper for you.
After your appointment, revise your essay carefully and upload the new version before the submission deadline.

collections.title: Campus Bank Orientation
collections.description: Repeat 6 sentences from the campus bank orientation campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to the Campus Bank.
Please take a number and wait.
Bring your student ID for account setup.
You can open checking or savings accounts here.
Deposits can be made through the ATM outside any time.
Remember to keep your pin private and never share it with anyone.

collections.title: International Office Advising
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the international office advising campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to the International Office.
Please sign in at the front desk.
Bring your passport and visa documents for verification.
Arrive at least 10 minutes before your appointment time.
Ask an advisor if you need help understanding immigration rules.
Get your email regularly for updates on visa renewals or travel authorizations.
Before you leave, schedule your next check-in and collect a receipt to keep for your records.

collections.title: Career Fair Preparation
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the career fair preparation campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to Career Fair Preparation Day.
Dress professionally and bring several copies of your resume.
Research the companies that will attend tomorrow.
Introduce yourself clearly when you meet a recruiter.
Ask short, specific questions about the positions offered.
Collect business cards and write thank you emails within 24 hours.
Before leaving the event, review your notes and plan which companies to follow up with next week.

collections.title: Study Abroad Information Session
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the study abroad information session campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to the study abroad office.
We help students apply for international programs.
Check application deadlines on the official university website.
Attend an orientation before submitting any documents or payments.
Ask your advisor which courses would transfer back for credit.
Prepare a short essay about your goals and how you represent our university abroad.
Before you travel review the packing list update your passport and confirm insurance coverage for your entire day.

collections.title: Student Theater Orientation
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the student theater orientation campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to the Student Theater.
Please sign in at the stage door.
Keep food and drinks out of the performance area.
Handle props and costumes with care at all times.
Arrive on time so rehearsals can start smoothly for everyone.
Listen to the director's instructions and support your teammates through each saying.
Before you leave, store equipment properly, turn off the lights, and make sure the stage is completely clean.

collections.title: Science Fair Setup
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the science fair setup campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to the Science Fair!
Please check in at the registration table.
Each project must have a clear label and title.
Keep food and drinks away from the display boards.
Plug in your equipment only after permission from the technician.
Stay near your booth to answer questions from judges and visitors.
Before leaving, remove all materials, clean your area, and thank the organizers for their support.

collections.title: Language Exchange Club
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the language exchange club campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to the Language Exchange Lab.
We meet every Wednesday evening.
Partners switch languages every 15 minutes.
Listen carefully and avoid correcting too much.
Use simple vocabulary when helping beginners express ideas.
Share something about your culture or traditions during each meeting.
Our goal is to practice fluency, build friendships, and appreciate the many languages spoken on campus.

collections.title: Campus Counseling Center Orientation
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the campus counseling center orientation campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to the Counseling Center.
All visits are private and confidential.
Appointments can be booked online or by phone.
Sessions usually last around 45 minutes each.
Counselors can help with stress, anxiety, and time management skills.
Emergency walk-ins are accepted when students need immediate support.
Before leaving, pick up a brochure and remember that free workshops are offered every month.

collections.title: Student ID Replacement Office
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the student id replacement office campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to the ID Replacement Office.
Report your lost card immediately to security.
Bring another form of photo identification for verification.
There is a small fee for printing a new card.
It usually takes about 10 minutes to process replacement.
Your old car will be deactivated to prevent unauthorized building access.
Before leaving, test your new ID at the door scanner to confirm it works correctly.

collections.title: University Orientation Day
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the university orientation day campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to University Orientation Day.
We're excited to have you here.
You'll meet your academic advisor later this morning.
Campus tours begin at the Student Union Building entrance.
Please ask questions if you need help finding classrooms or facilities.
Today's activities include workshops, games, and a welcome lunch for all new students.
By the end of orientation, you'll know how to register for classes, use resources, and join student organizations.

collections.title: Campus Safety Briefing
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the campus safety briefing campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to the Campus Safety Briefing.
Always carry your student ID card.
Report suspicious activity to security immediately.
Use well lit pass when walking alone at night.
Emergency phones are located across campus near parking lots and hallways.
Save the campus emergency number in your phone for quick access.
If an alarm sounds, follow directions calmly and help others exit the building safely and quickly.

collections.title: Student Housing Office Visit
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the student housing office visit campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to the Student Housing Office.
Please take a number and wait patiently.
Bring your student ID and room key for verification.
Submit maintenance requests through the online housing portal.
Room changes are available only during the first two weeks of the semester.
For safety reasons, do not attempt to fix electrical issues yourself.
Before leaving, confirm your request status and check your email for housing updates from our staff.

collections.title: University Gym Class Check-In
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the university gym class check-in campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to your first gym class.
Please place your bags by the wall.
Wear comfortable shoes for exercise today.
Warm up before starting any physical activity.
Drink water frequently to stay hydrated during class.
Listen carefully to the instructor's directions to avoid possible injuries.
Before you leave, stretch your muscles properly, clean the equipment, and return all items to the original place.

collections.title: Career Skills Workshop
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the career skills workshop campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to the Career Skills Workshop.
Please sign your name on the attendance sheet.
Today's topic is effective communication at work.
Speak clearly and make eye contact with your partner.
Practice answering interview questions using short, confident sentences.
Bring your resume for feedback from the workshop facilitator later today.
After the session, review your notes carefully and apply what you learned in mock interviews and job applications.

collections.title: Student Art Exhibition Setup
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the student art exhibition setup campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to the student art exhibition.
Handle all artwork gently and with care.
Place each piece according to the display plan.
Keep food and drinks away from the gallery floor.
Lighting adjustments must be approved by the event coordinator first.
Hope your classmates arrange labels and hang paintings evenly on the wall.
Before leaving, double check the layout, remove packing labels, and thank the curator for their assistance.

collections.title: Graduation Rehearsal Instructions
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the graduation rehearsal instructions campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to graduation rehearsal today.
Please find your assigned seat by row.
Listen for your name during the line up practice.
Walk slowly across the stage when it's your turn.
Stand with the dean and smile for the photographer.
Remain seated until all graduates have received their diplomas on stage.
Before leaving, return your gown bag, check the final schedule, and confirm your arrival time for Ceremony Day.

collections.title: Computer Security Training
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the computer security training campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to Computer Security Training.
Keep your passwords private and secure.
Change them every few months for protection.
Never click links from unknown email addresses.
Install antivirus software and update it regularly on your device.
Report suspicious messages or files immediately to the IT support office.
Practicing safe browsing, data backup, and awareness can protect your personal information from online threats effectively.

collections.title: Campus Tour Guide Practice
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the campus tour guide practice campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to tour guide training.
Speak clearly so visitors can hear you.
Smile and make eye contact with your group.
Point out landmarks, and explain their significance briefly.
Answer questions politely, and keep the tour moving on schedule.
Avoid blocking hallways or interrupting classes while walking through buildings.
At the end of the tour, thank your guests sincerely and remind them to visit the information desk for brochures.

collections.title: Student Wellness Fair
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the student wellness fair campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to the Student Wellness Fair.
Please sign in at the front table.
Pick up a free wellness guide and water bottle.
Visit each booth to learn about fitness and nutrition.
Ask professionals for advice on managing stress and sleep effectively.
Join our mindfulness workshop starting in the community room at noon.
Before leaving, complete the short feedback survey and collect your participation certificate from the registration desk.

collections.title: Final Exam Instructions
collections.description: Repeat 7 sentences from the final exam instructions campus scenario.

prompts.transcript: Welcome to your final exam session.
Place all bags under your desk.
Turn off and store your cell phones now.
Write your full name on the top of every page.
You may not leave the room during the first 30 minutes.
If you have questions, raise your hand quietly and wait for assistance.
When finished, review your answers carefully, staple all pages, and submit your exam to the proctor before leaving.
